DefaultDialogue: So<g id="male_lookaroundSmall" /> much destruction… I'm amazed anyone survived this.
So<g id="male_lookaroundSmall" /> much destruction… I'm amazed anyone survived this.
What<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> horrors have occurred here…
<g id="male_convince02" />Thank goodness you're here! It's all my fault - I<g id="female_lookdownSorry" /> led the Wardens right into an ambush. The Corrupted were waiting.
I<g id="male_lookdownAshamed" /> feel terrible. I promised everyone we'd be safe here.
I must seek to<g id="female_worry" /> learn the Empress's fate at the earliest opportunity - after we have found somewhere secure.
If Master Qi has fallen to Corruption… this day will grow darker indeed.
<g id="female_gestureRightM" />The hope and drive we had at Caer Dun seem impossible<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> to recreate. Everyone is despondent, particularly Yash.
The Corrupted have conquered much, but<g id="female_crossarms" /> the Empress and her Dynasty forces hold the town, the monastery, and the shipyard.
Of the tea, I<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> encourage you to gather an appreciable amount. Too little would be insulting; too much would be obsequious.
Court whispers do not<g id="female_lookaroundConfused" /> travel far under Empress Zhou's rule, but Lingyun has whispered to me. You seek to heal Liang?
<g id="male_headShakeNo" />I had never before considered individual plant matter connected by<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> a deeper "root system" that was not physical.
As the ingredients combined into this remedy, so too<g id="male_leanforwardInspect" /> have our efforts combined into this chance to save Prince Liang.
The incense is<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> complete! I have done all I can to ensure its success and I am optimistic,<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> though my trembling may say otherwise.
The trial<g id="male_whisperForwardShort" /> below must be yours alone. Worry not, from this vantage I can best advise you and stoke the incense further.
Incredible!<g id="female_shakeheadNo" /> It worked… we have extracted his human soul from his monstrous body.<g id="female_lookRight" /> I… can't believe it.
I worry for his reticence and yet my heart<g id="female_lookRight" /> is full to bursting at the sight of his sweet face.
As far as I can<g id="female_lookRight" /> tell, Liang is… physically healthy. I scarcely believe it.
It's good to see Liang return<g id="male_gestureHereweare" /> to familiar surroundings… though I fear they aren't yet familiar in his mind.
I…<g id="female_crossarms" /> wanted to speak before you go. This has been exhausting on many levels and I need rest before joining you.
Is<g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" /> it true? The Empress, fallen to Corruption? I did not think it possible of someone so strong.
We<g id="female_bowHead" /> will speak in a moment, Warden.
That was... kind<g id="male_itsokay" /> of you. I hope with that, Liang can find closure and begin a new life. But he is going to need help.
Empress Zhou always<g id="male_nodProud" /> wanted Liang to one day rule in her stead,<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> regardless of the immortality bestowed on this island.
Proud<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> Caer Dun… now in shambles.
I will follow you soon.<g id="male_dontknowS" /> I recognize there is nothing here left to protect. Only ash.

I'm sorry,<g id="male_apologize" /> I should pull myself together. Yonas would want us to push on,<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> but I don't know how. The Wardens…<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> is this the end?
I see you're safe, and are those supplies? We can certainly put those to use right away. This place hardly feels like home.
Disguising the tents<g id="female_lookConcern" /> will make us a little less exposed, but I still don't like this place…
Thank you. I'm sorry if I was rude before. Everyone's efforts to make this camp feel more safe are… appreciated.
<g id="female_explainS" />Please. I need some time, Warden.
Is that… a flag from Caer Dun?<g id="male_dazed" /> The symbol of the Soulwardens. Not long ago, I was so inspired by that.
I<g id="male_saluteFistToChest" /> bring word from Great Cleave and beyond. Once you are ready, we should strategize.
Well, this is a right mess now, isn't it?<g id="grace_handheart" /> I had really come to like the old man, and now he's gone. It's just rotten.
Look at you,<g id="grace_wherearewe" /> here to finish the job. Did you find the others then? I was planning to circle back, you know.
I'll keep an eye out<g id="grace_fisthigh" /> for the others till you get back. Then we can plan our next steps.
Now<g id="grace_welcome" /> there's a spot of hope! We'll get that banner mended, just as soon as we find a safe place to make camp.
Lucky for you, your<g id="grace_crossarms" /> pal Grace has an eye for places to duck and hide, and I found a spot as safe as can be hoped for.
Got some more scouting to do before I head back. I'll<g id="grace_salutefingers" /> see you soon enough.
<g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />So Sun's finally setting out to search for her precious Empress?<g id="grace_dismiss" /> Don't get me wrong, we could use allies right now.
A<g id="grace_fisthigh" /> banner! Look at me, coming up with a project all of a sudden like that. Masterpiece<g id="grace_gestureU" /> of an idea, that is.
Just happened to be in town on<g id="grace_crossarms" /> business, and I hear tales of your heroics. I'm seeing light on the horizon.
<g id="grace_shrugDontknow" />So Sun's found a role for me to play in this drama, after all.<g id="grace_casualHail" /> I'm to escort the young prince to a monastery down south.
Hell's<g id="grace_throwarms" /> breath, what took you so damn long? It's bloody madness - the Corrupted are here… and that harpy Isabella too.
If I was<g id="grace_understand" /> placing a bet, I'd wager the Empress is planning to give Isabella the slip and leave without her.
You have the Seals yet? You<g id="grace_dismiss" /> better hurry! The Empress is about to shove off!
I can handle the captain, but I'm not<g id="grace_lean" /> so sure about the Empress. Since when can the Corrupted float around like that?
To be present in life is to be free.
A rare visitor, in these times. But<g id="yonas_bowShallow" priority="high" /> you are most welcome to join me in my meditations.
Without<g id="yonas_spreadarms001" priority="high" /> reflection, you will find no harmony. Now, come, meditate with me.
Your sense of self is in<g id="yonas_explain02" priority="high" /> disarray… a weakness that this intruding influence is exploiting to enter your thoughts.
Three<g id="yonas_spreadarms001" priority="high" /> sources of music. But can they all sing together?
Very good.<g id="yonas_headupSatisfied" priority="high" /> Not so easy, is it? But did you only focus on those objects? Or did you understand the meaning behind the actions?
Reflect<g id="yonas_bowShallow" priority="high" /> on the lesson. I think you will find much benefit in its simplicity.
My royal audience is not yet prepared for you. Return to me at a later time.
My handmaiden tells me your order has suffered much from the Corrupted, and so it is with Ebonscale as well.
You have proven yourself a capable, honorable, and worthy friend to Ebonscale… and an enemy to the Corruption.
Poems, as I am sure you are aware, are such heartfelt stories contained in so few words.
And so, my plight: Isabella presses upon my wisdom while the Corruption manipulates my desperation. They are strong.
I put my trust in you, and yet you parade before me this wretch who cannot speak? You dare mock Empress Zhou Taiying!?
There are so<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> many more people in this world… than I remembered.
Mother…
My body…<g id="female_lookConcern" /> feels strange. I think I was… like that… for far longer than I was ever in this form. Is this even... me?
Sun told me... how many<g id="male_dazed" /> years it has been. Were any of my toys still… in good condition?
There are so<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> many more people in this world… than I remembered.
I know that I too… have words<g id="male_guiltyLookdown" /> inside. Unlike Mother's poems they are difficult to… find.
It is me, Mother… it is…
The<g id="male_lookupSmall" /> Heavens are… so quiet now.
This<g id="female_takeitem" /> is… for me?
Ohh, how I have<g id="male_handheart" /> missed the deepness of the sky…
Hopefully the Tempest will not find<g id="male_lookside" /> us here… I could not face her again.
I hate seeing everyone so demoralized. But<g id="male_sighRelief" /> at least we are all together.
Glad you're here! I was following the noise of Grace's gunshots, but… they've gone silent now.
The<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> mountains here are incredible. If only... we could have journeyed here under happier circumstances.
So<g id="male_lookDown" /> many of us gone now… Are the Soulwardens finished, do you think?
I never had the chance to tell Yonas those old stories of mine. He was so patient with me. And I was so… uncertain.
My thanks, Warden! Hurry after Wayne. He tried to make a break for it, but I don't know if he was able to dodge the patrols.
